gloss: to pay a price; to pay compensation

definitions.gloss: to pay a price (for something); to pay compensation; to give something in return
definitions.explanation: Collocation meaning to hand over money or another form of value in exchange for a good, service, or benefit. Often used in the literal, commercial sense, but also figuratively for "paying a price" in effort, sacrifice, or consequences.

examples.japanese: ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対価|たいか}を{払|はら}う。
⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正当|せいとう}→正当：13191_seitou⟧な{対価|たいか}を{払|はら}うべきだ。
examples.english: Fair compensation should be paid for labor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦プライバシー→プライバシー：06806_puraibashii⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{対価|たいか}を{払|はら}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: To gain convenience, we are paying the price of privacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{対価|たいか}を{払|はら}ってきた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だ。
examples.english: Even he, who achieved success, had paid the heavy price of time with his family.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{対価|たいか}→対価：12434_taika⟧ (consideration, price paid in return) and ⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay). The noun ⟦{対価|たいか}→対価：12434_taika⟧ refers specifically to something given in return for something received — payment in the economic sense, or more abstractly the "price" paid in sacrifice or consequence.

USAGE:
- Literal, commercial sense: paying money for goods, services, or labor
- Figurative sense: giving up something valuable (time, freedom, health) as the cost of something gained
- Formal and somewhat abstract; in casual contexts, ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ is far more common for literal payments

REGISTER: Formal/written; common in business, legal, ethical, and essayistic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正当|せいとう}→正当：13191_seitou⟧な{対価|たいか}を{払|はら}う: to pay a fair price/compensation
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な{対価|たいか}を{払|はら}う: to pay appropriate compensation
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{対価|たいか}を{払|はら}う: to pay a great price (often figurative)
- ⟦{対価|たいか}→対価：12434_taika⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive as compensation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the price (of goods) — more concrete and commercial
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay a fee — for services, utilities, admission
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay a reward/compensation — for labor, especially professional
- ⟦{代償|だいしょう}→代償：11432_daishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay a price (usually figurative, often negative) — emphasizes sacrifice or consequence more than {対価|たいか}を{払|はら}う
